items.title: What FLARE's Published Numbers Actually Measure
items.claim: FLARE scores measure extraction-rule choice more than model quality because unspecified rules leave scores partially identified.

items.title: MBABench-2.0: Evaluating AI Agents on Constructing Financial Spreadsheets Beyond Simple Verifiability
items.claim: Frontier agents cannot yet build spreadsheets that are both accurate and maintainable, with top pass rate at 16%.

items.title: Optimal Size in Market Making under State-Dependent Hawkes Process
items.claim: State-dependent Hawkes calibrated quoting achieves higher terminal utility than a baseline while respecting inventory bounds.

items.title: Cross-Bond Panel Learning for Next-Day Price Forecasting of Chinese Convertible Bonds: A Reality Check
items.claim: Cross-bond neural networks fail to outperform the random walk for next-day convertible bond price forecasting.

items.title: Towards Adversarially Robust Multigraph Neural Networks for Financial Crime Analysis
items.claim: Learned structural attacks reduce multigraph neural network AML detection, while adversarial training improves defense against them.

items.title: Operationalizing Governed Agentic Workflows in Regulated Finance: A Customer Zero Case Study using Zafin AIOS
items.claim: Governed agentic orchestration increases enterprise capacity without compromising control, cutting pricing effort by 38%.
